mapper.insert: INSERT INTO datasource_config (datasource_id, name, type, host, port, db_name, username, password, description, enabled, tenant_id, user_id, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{datasourceId}, #{name}, #{type}, #{host}, #{port}, #{dbName}, #{username}, #{password,typeHandler=com.ai.persistence.EncryptedStringTypeHandler}, #{description}, #{enabled}, #{tenantId}, #{userId}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE datasource_config SET name = #{name}, type = #{type}, host = #{host}, port = #{port}, db_name = #{dbName}, username = #{username}, password = #{password,typeHandler=com.ai.persistence.EncryptedStringTypeHandler}, description = #{description}, enabled = #{enabled}, tenant_id = #{tenantId}, user_id = #{userId}, created_at = #{createdAt}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE datasource_id = #{datasourceId}
